issue.title: Expose temperature

labels.name: beginner
labels.description: A good issue for someone that only gets started

issue.body: I would like to be able to read HIGHRES_IMU.temperature

comments.body: @julianoes: is that `Info` or `Telemetry`? Or something else?

I might be completely off in the idea behind the SDK, but why would you not expose all mavlink topics and allow getting updates? You can still create wrappers around standard things but you are not limiting devs to access all telemetry information.

Same goes for sending stuff, its good to have wrappers for everything the SDK understands, but a generic message factory such as dronekit/pymavlink would serve as a fall-back for anything unknown to the SDK or custom added to Mavlink.
Yes, a "backdoor" like that is something we probably should do. But that's orthogonal to this request.

This has been added to the C++ API:
https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/blob/221bd80fd96f5524da2a14f4f5f46eb667e411e4/src/plugins/telemetry/include/plugins/telemetry/telemetry.h#L177
but it's missing in Python, so it needs to be added to the proto file here:
https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK-Proto/blob/master/protos/telemetry/telemetry.proto

issue.title: Add MAVLink pass-through plugin

repository.name: MAVSDK
repository.description: API and library for MAVLink compatible systems written in C++ 20

issue.body:
This adds a backdoor to send and receive direct/raw MAVLink messages.

> "With great power comes great responsibility." 
> This plugin allows you to send and receive MAVLink messages. There is no checking or safe-guards, you're on your own, and you have been warned.


This should close #652, #651.

To compile this in you need to actually do:
```
make ENABLE_MAVLINK_PASSTHROUGH=1
```

issue.title: Telemetry: add angular velocity and acceleration

repository.name: MAVSDK
repository.description: API and library for MAVLink compatible systems written in C++ 20

issue.body:
1. adds struct IMUReadingNED encompassing acceleration ,angular speed, magnetic field and temperature
2. adds setters and getters(both synchronous and asynchronous for interacting with acceleration and angular speed) and a process function for getting the desired info from the mavlink message.





Resolves #754 and #651

timeline.body:
This has been added to the C++ API:
https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/blob/221bd80fd96f5524da2a14f4f5f46eb667e411e4/src/plugins/telemetry/include/plugins/telemetry/telemetry.h#L177
but it's missing in Python, so it needs to be added to the proto file here:
https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK-Proto/blob/master/protos/telemetry/telemetry.proto
